notes: HOTFIX for v3.533: unconditionally cleans up the guessed 'include cursor' registry writes that broke NVIDIA App for some customers. Every Myst launch now deletes HKCU ShadowPlay\NVSPCAPS\CursorEnabled + DVRCursorEnabled and HKLM NvContainer\ShadowPlay\bDVRCursorEnabled + bCursorEnabled (and removes the subkey if empty), so anyone whose NVIDIA App won't open gets it back the next time Myst boots. Cursor visibility is now 100% controlled by the NVIDIA App preference as originally intended. Also: fixed second-monitor duplication crash on Alt+Tab out of fullscreen Roblox (DXGI_ERROR_ACCESS_LOST is properly released with a cooldown before reinit). Moved Config panel into the empty right-column slot in Settings so it stops hugging the bottom-left corner.
